meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 执行后,Claude 会读取项目代码,整理出其中有哪些业务板块和先后环节,画成一张可点击的流程图并在看板中展示。如果之前已通过 /understand 记录过代码结构,就直接复用;否则会先快速扫描一遍代码再整理。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析代码库的业务板块、梳理业务环节,或执行 /understand-domain 命令时。

say.text: 调用 /understand-domain,分析这个项目里的业务环节。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码,在看板中生成业务流程图。

say.text: 之前 /understand 已跑过,基于它生成领域流程图。
say.note: 复用已有记录,不重新扫描代码。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts the business modules and process steps from the code, draws an interactive flow graph, and opens it in the dashboard. If an /understand knowledge graph exists, it reuses it; otherwise it does a quick scan first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze business areas in the code, sort out its process steps, or runs the /understand-domain command.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain to analyze the business flows in this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans the code and shows a flow graph in the dashboard.

say_en.text: You already ran /understand before; base the domain flow graph on it.
say_en.note: Uses the existing data without rescanning.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain --full to rescan everything and regenerate.
say_en.note: Forces a full rescan even if a graph already exists.
